fact: The Global Fund's Inspector General reported on 29 April 2019 that DHIS2, rolled out as the health management information system in 2015-17, was used for malaria in almost all 18 states but not in their health facilities: results from health facilities were manually consolidated and then entered in DHIS2, and only 32% of health facilities were included by states in DHIS2.
title: Global Fund Grants in the Republic of Sudan (Audit Report GF-OIG-19-010)
publisher: The Global Fund, Office of the Inspector General
